data: In the leftmost plot, what is the value of the red line with x-axis 0.7?

The leftmost plot shows three lines representing precision, recall, and F-measure. The red line represents recall. The x-axis ranges from 0.3 to 0.7. The y-axis ranges from 0.3 to 0.9. The red line intersects the x-axis at approximately 0.7. The value of the red line at x=0.7 appears to be around 0.4. Therefore, the value of the red line with x-axis 0.7 is approximately 0.4.
